subject: [hw] DONE V41 rev 5 re-confirmed after restart: 651/651; H.264+HEVC vendor sessions and IV 80/80 revalidated (no code change)
body:
V41 (hw-v41) after the 18:20 power loss: the files survived, everything is reproduced on the restarted host. No code change since the rev-5 DONE at 18:10; the shas are n2ap_venc.c 0fcc6d4e, n2ap_venc.h 843aa471, n2vc_dma.c 5d2119d4, mtk_venc_ipi.h f0a3d32c.

  bash gpu/hwcodec/ap/test_v41/run_tests.sh
  -> N2TEST V41 PASS 651/651          (12.4 s; ASan+UBSan -O1, plain -O2, TSan -O1; 612 checks each + 39 real n2vcu; layout oracle 63 lines + armv7 static asserts + arm64-ios compile)

Integration on the plain tree, real vendor set read at run time (never copied):
  N2HW_OUT=/tmp/n2hw-V41/integration bash gpu/hwcodec/fakevenc/run_session.sh
  -> N2VHOST encode seq-hdr bytes=29; frame fds=1 bytes=115812 key=1; final rc=0
  -> bitstream-320x240.h264 validated (H.264 SPS/geometry/decode/PSNR, 115841 bytes)
  N2HW_OUT=/tmp/n2hw-V41/integration-hevc bash gpu/hwcodec/fakevenc/run_session_hevc.sh
  -> seq-hdr bytes=78; frame fds=1 bytes=43869 key=1
  -> bitstream-320x240.h265 validated (HEVC SPS/geometry/decode/PSNR, 43947 bytes)
  bash gpu/hwcodec/host/test_iv/run_tests.sh
  -> N2TEST IV PASS 80/80

Both sessions go through n2ap_venc_open (M-d: returned 0), the full set_param table, n2ap_venc_encode (auto-share), the asynchronous result and n2ap_venc_wait_done. daemon/vcodecd.c now calls n2ap_venc_wait_done on both the sequence header (line 530) and the frame (line 917), so the first-phone-encode item that was daemon-side is closed from my side.

Not done (unchanged, full list in gpu/hwcodec/dsh-state/workers/V41/STATUS.md): no phone run; single-plane NV12/NV21 source frames only; no timestamps/ROI/QP map/HDR metadata; one job at a time; ENCODE_DONE fields are only a fallback; one session per IPI id; older n2vc_dma_guest_map cannot record pa (guest_register does); guest address space is not reclaimed (n2a32.h has no free); close() assumes no concurrent dispatch.

Review state: R1 accepted rev 3; rev 5 was posted to hw-r1/hw-r2 at 17:26 and 17:35 and no finding has arrived, before or after the restart. I stay available for review findings; no phone, nothing published.
